messages:
Maria: Heads-up — scheduling a targeted deploy to eu-west and us-west tonight 23:00 UTC. This includes runtime 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 and a small model-store migration for Dedicated pools. Need statuspage + customer email copy. Who can draft?

Sam: I can do statuspage + email snippets. Timeline and rollback criteria?

Maria: Timeline: start 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC, 60m change window. Canary in eu-west for 10m, then stagger to us-west. If canary error rate > 1% or latency p95 jumps > 300ms we abort and rollback. If rollback happens we pin affected Dedicated customers to runtime 1.3.2 and notify.

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy queued: region=eu-west, owner=maria, change_window=2026-03-21T23:00Z-2026-03-22T00:00Z, canary=10m. Note: automatic start at 23:00 UTC unless manual hold.

Jules: Add a line for sales/CS: "We may pin certain enterprise tenants to the previous runtime to maintain stability." @Sam please include that in the customer-facing copy.

Ana: Ops checklist (preflight):
- 22:30 UTC: take model-store snapshot
- 22:40 UTC: warm KV caches for top 50 prefixes
- 22:50 UTC: drain non-critical batch workers in eu-west
- 22:55 UTC: run smoke test script: scripts/smoke_inference.sh
If any step fails we abort and open an incident.

Kevin: Oncall ack. Rollback plan summary: immediate rollback -> pin customers -> open statuspage incident with "degraded" template -> deploy hotfix to canary branch. Rollback script: ops/rollback_runtime.sh (keeps config and routes intact).

Sam: Statuspage snippet draft (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance: March 21 23:00 UTC — EU / US-W
We will perform a planned runtime upgrade of our inference service in eu-west and us-west. During the window (up to 60 minutes) some Dedicated pools may see elevated latency or brief errors. We will failover affected customers to a pinned runtime 1.3.2 if stability issues are detected.
Start: 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC
Duration: up to 60 minutes
Affected: Dedicated pools in eu-west, us-west
Impact: Brief increased latency or errors for a subset of customers.
```

Maria: Email subject: "Planned maintenance: inference runtime upgrade — Mar 21 23:00 UTC"
Sam: Email body draft (short):
```
Hi —
We are performing a planned upgrade to our inference runtime on Mar 21 at 23:00 UTC for eu-west and us-west. The work will take up to 60 minutes. During this time you may experience elevated latency or brief errors on Dedicated pools. If we detect instability we will pin affected Dedicated customers to the previous runtime (v1.3.2) to preserve availability.
If you rely on strict SLAs or have critical jobs during this window, reply and we will coordinate a carve-out.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

Jules: + please add a line telling customers how to reach us for urgent carve-outs (support@redwood.ai and phone for enterprise).

Sam: Added. I'll post to statuspage and queue the email to the dedicated-cust list 1 hour prior (22:00 UTC) and again 15 minutes prior.

Maria: Good. Quick note: we will not auto-retry failing model uploads during the migration window; ops will handle retries after validation.

Kevin: I'll be present for canary and first 30m. If DeployBot shows any errors, I'll hit the manual hold and ping this thread.

Maria: Perfect. I'll kick off the canary start at 23:00 and ping every +5m with status. @DeployBot, please add deploy log link here when started. :thumbsup:
